mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases risk of metoclopramide-induced tardive dyskinesia and cardiac arrhythmias; metoclopramide may impair gastric absorption of chlorthalidone.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, consider limiting metoclopramide duration to <3 months, and use alternative antiemetics if possible.
